measurementBoundaries.wall: All contribution sums use actual disjoint tick interval durations, never sums of P95. Per-request wall + pre-request idle-eligible gap + due gap + phase-tail exactly reconciles schedule elapsed.
measurementBoundaries.allocations: Named synchronous current-UI-thread stage allocation observations only; hit uses the HitTestPoint timing. Counts/identity/driver/native/render-thread allocations are not observed here. Sums are a partial allocation observation, not total request/process allocation.
measurementBoundaries.record: Record interval includes new DrawingGroup + chart.Render + recursive Leaves(group) primitive counting. This raw evidence cannot separate chart work from Leaves measurement overhead.
measurementBoundaries.hit: Timed hit is HitTestPoint only. Query preparation, source identity validation and Counts are in residual inside request, not folded into timed hit.
measurementBoundaries.postHit: hitEnd-to-end includes identity validation, query-result construction, Counts, guard and timing bookkeeping; not an isolated Counts timer.
measurementBoundaries.dueGap: request - max(previous end, scheduled), including Emit JSONL, Background dispatcher scheduling, background rendering/other activity and delay/spin overshoot. It is outside chart operation timings and cannot be attributed solely to controllable chart production work.
measurementBoundaries.queue: Arrival lateness and finish debt are queue state, not disjoint wall work. Do not sum lateness and call it CPU time. Signed per-request debt deltas telescope to final recorded-request debt; negative narrow requests can repay dense debt.
measurementBoundaries.slotIntent: Source replacement inherits previous viewport; measured index0 inherits warmup's final narrow range. Classification uses actual range and actual point counts, not action or modulo alone.
measurementBoundaries.missing: Unattempted planned requests have no timing/allocation observations. Their intention counts are descriptive only, not imputed measured costs.
measurementBoundaries.causality: Current B18 within-campaign accounting identifies expensive intervals, not a proof that eliminating one method will improve independent formal results. No B17 comparison or rejected native candidate result is used.
